addressGoes: the Meta app's dashboard → Messenger API Settings → Configure webhooks → Callback URL, with FACEBOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN as the Verify Token

settings.description: The token Meta sends back when it checks your server's address: any text of your own, entered as the webhook's Verify Token.

why.maxTextLength: Messenger takes 2,000 characters in a message's text. The adapter cuts a longer one to 1,997 and three dots (MESSENGER_MESSAGE_LIMIT, truncateMessage) and says nothing, so the rest of an answer would be lost.
why.addressGoes: The adapter's settings are the app's secret, the Page's token and the verify token: not the app's ID, which the call that sets a webhook's address needs. Meta checks the address as it is saved, with a GET the adapter answers, so the server has to be running.
why.plainText: Messenger shows text as it is typed. The adapter sends Markdown as its source (fromAst), so a person would read **Plan A** and 3\. Pick A.
why.settings: The verify token is the caller's own choice: Meta is given it with the address, and sends it back in the GET it checks the address with (hub.verify_token), which the adapter compares with this setting.
